product_name.format: A product name string; varies by sourcetype and, on the alert sourcetype, by when the alert was raised.

examples.note: legacy alert product name and the constant this pack observed on every recommendation

alert_type.format: A dotted or underscored code naming the detection logic.

alert_display_name.format: A short human title for the alert.

alert_description.format: One or two sentences of free text.

examples.value: Suspicious process named 'SVCHOST.EXE' was running from path: %{Process Path}
examples.note: %{...} is a literal placeholder token in this sample, not substituted

Active.meaning: An alert which does not specify a value is assigned this status.

InProgress.meaning: The alert is in a handling state.

Resolved.meaning: The alert was closed after handling.

Dismissed.meaning: The alert was dismissed as a false positive.

New.meaning: Observed on both of this pack's samples; not in the documented enum.

confidence_level.quote: The confidence level of this alert

intent.format: One fixed word naming a kill chain stage.

Unknown.meaning: The kill chain stage could not be classified.

PreAttack.meaning: An attempt to access a resource, or a failed attempt to gain access, prior to exploitation.

InitialAccess.meaning: The attacker got a foothold on the resource.

Persistence.meaning: An access, action or configuration change giving the actor a lasting presence.

PrivilegeEscalation.meaning: The actor obtained a higher permission level.

DefenseEvasion.meaning: Techniques used to evade detection or other defenses.

CredentialAccess.meaning: Access to or control over credentials.

Discovery.meaning: The actor gathered knowledge about the system or network.

LateralMovement.meaning: The actor accessed or controlled remote systems on the network.

Execution.meaning: Adversary controlled code ran on a local or remote system.

Collection.meaning: The actor identified and gathered information prior to exfiltration.

Exfiltration.meaning: The actor removed files or information from the network.

CommandAndControl.meaning: How the actor communicates with systems under its control.

Impact.meaning: The actor tried to reduce availability or integrity, or manipulate data.

Probing.meaning: An attempt to access a resource, or a failed attempt to gain access, prior to exploitation.

Exploitation.meaning: The attacker got a foothold on a compute host or resource such as a user account or certificate.

correlation_key.format: An opaque string, base64 shaped in this pack's sample.

examples.note: from the vendor's own REST API example, not this pack's sample

azure_resource_id.format: An Azure Resource Manager path, /subscriptions/{id}/resourceGroups/{name}/providers/{provider}/{type}/{name}, cased however the source cased it.

examples.note: an all zero placeholder in the sample alert

agent_id.format: A GUID in most samples; not always well formed.

examples.note: 35 characters in this pack's sample, one short of a well formed GUID

LogAnalytics.meaning: Points at a Log Analytics workspace rather than an Azure Resource Manager resource.
LogAnalytics.quote: A Log Analytics workspace scope identifier.

AAD.meaning: Observed on this pack's sample; not in the documented enum (AzureResource, LogAnalytics only).

entities.format: A small integer as a string, used only to cross reference other entities in the same list.

gcp-resource.meaning: A Google Cloud resource, seen on a multicloud connected alert.

entity_properties.format: Depends on the sibling Type value: an ip entity carries Address and Location, a process entity carries ProcessId and CommandLine, each entity type its own field set, none enumerated on one page.

extended_links.format: A link's Category, Href, Label and Type.

extended_properties.format: A free-form bag; keys vary by alert type and some contain spaces.

alert_uri.format: An Azure Portal deep link URL.

system_alert_id.format: A long numeric prefix, an underscore, then a GUID.

instance.meaning: Seen on the one sample event with ExtendedProperties.resourceType Virtual Machine.

alert_src_ip.format: An IPv4 address string, repeated once per matching entity.

assessment_key.format: A GUID, shared by every resource one assessment type ran against.

resource_details_source.format: One fixed word in this pack's samples; the schema also allows OnPremise and OnPremiseSql for other resource kinds.

Azure.meaning: The assessed resource is an Azure resource.

examples.value: Install endpoint protection solution on virtual machine scale sets

Unhealthy.meaning: Defender found a security issue on the resource that still needs fixing.
Unhealthy.quote: The resource has a security issue that needs to be addressed.

NotApplicable.meaning: The assessment did not happen for this resource.

assessment_status_cause.format: One fixed word; the schema names no fixed list.

OffByPolicy.meaning: This pack's one observed value: the effective Azure Policy assignment evaluated the assessment off.

examples.value: The effective policy for the assessment was evaluated to off - use Microsoft.Authorization/policyAssignments to turn this assessment on

linked_workspace_id.format: An Azure Resource Manager path to a Log Analytics workspace.

assessment_metadata.format: Absent in every sample this pack indexed.
